qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 3c84614 and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit fdd485e found every finding resolved or kept as an accepted optional remainder. Correctness reported no findings: every example translation matches its Japanese in state, transitivity, appointment and election, を境に, を通じて and によると; 夫妻 keeps its own-family restriction, 大家 keeps its separate おおや and たいか entries and the gender-neutral landlord explanation, and «полночь» is cautioned against only as exactly 00:00. Its optional precision note on 地方:35 was superseded when the sentence was deleted. Consistency raised one minor finding, fixed: 大's title «большой размер; огромный (как приставка)» shares «огромный» with 巨大 «громадный; гигантский», which had no guard although the batch guards 莫大, so 大 now also excludes 巨大. Comprehensibility raised three minor findings, all fixed: 地方:35 rejected an English word-list gloss («побережье») that the card never presents, and too absolutely, since JMdict and Digital Daijisen give the coast sense to the separate reading じかた, so the sentence was deleted; 大統領:32 rendered the familiar vocative (JMdict "big man; boss; buddy; mate", especially of an actor) with the praise «молодчина!», now «шеф!» or «дружище!», without a flat no-praise contrast, because Digital Daijisen's actor call is itself an encouraging cheer; 大部分 did not separate itself from ほとんど, whose title shares «большая часть», so a plain-text sentence now names ほとんど's «почти» and negative «почти не» uses and denies only the negative to 大部分, since Digital Daijisen and Nihon Kokugo Daijiten allow adverbial 大部分 in the sense «почти». Before the candidate the coordinator retitled 大部分 «большая часть; большинство», 大半 «большинство; в основном», 報告 «отчёт; сообщение о результатах» and 外交 «дипломатия; отношения с другими странами», removed the author's combining stress marks and rephrased 大部分:25. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 18 EN exclusions across 12 lists are retained. Fifteen direct, one-sided exclusions on nine new cards cover reviewed RU title overlaps and sense neighbours. Required (12): 大部分–ほとんど, 大部分–たいてい, 大半–ほとんど, 大半–たいてい (shared «большая часть» or «большинство»), 大–莫大, 大–巨大 and 大–大小 (大's «огромный» and «размер»), 夢中–熱中, 外す–下ろす (shared «снимать»), 報告–リポート (shared «отчёт»), よる–次第 and 地方–州 (shared «провинция»). Conservative (3): 境–瞬間, 報告–知らせる and 報告–伝える. 大–巨大 was the consistency reviewer's one finding and was added in the fix. The author report announced 15 RU-added pairs but listed the 14 that reached the candidate, calling 5 required; the consistency reviewer rated 11 of the 14 required and found none unjustified, and its classification is recorded. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 35 relative links across the 21 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions, using EN's href forms: in the kanji pages, three each in 告 and 報 (to 報告), 夫 and 婦 (to 夫婦) and 球 (to 地球), and two each in 城 (to 城), 域 (to 地域) and 塔 (to 塔); in the word cards, two in 首相 (one each to 大臣 and 大統領) and one each in 地 and 環境 (to 地球), 妻, 独身 and 結婚 (to 夫婦), 婦人 (to 夫人), 日中 (to 夜中), 熱中 (to 夢中), 発表 (to 報告, keeping EN's ../words/ form), 縁 (to 境), 誇り (to 埃) and 首都 (to 地方). Mentions that EN leaves unlinked stay plain. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 52 selected 30 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 5 of the 72-batch dependency-closed queue of the general remaining-word pool (recomputed after Batch 207 from 2,157 remaining EN words). Its closure under the source quiz-exclusion edges is exactly the 30 requested words; nothing was added. 大半→大部分, 基づく→よる and 地方→地域 are the dependency edges inside the batch.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped (4 EN link occurrences, 4 targets): 大臣→kanji 臣; 大統領→kanji 領; 境→kanji 境; 大使→代表. 8 written kanji have no RU kanji card: 臣, 統, 領, 墓, 境, 塀, 基, 埃. No RU-only links were added (EN link parity).

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: the consistency reviewer's further title overlaps 地球–地, 地域–近所 and 報告–教える, because each mirrors an EN pair without an exact shared title segment and 地 teaches the planet/ground split; the reviewer accepted the decline in its recheck. The correctness reviewer's optional qualification of 地方:35 by the reading ちほう was superseded by deleting the sentence. The comprehensibility reviewer's polish notes (the provenance sentence in よる:26, 夢中/熱中, 基づく/よる and 報告/レポート without explicit contrasts, the «после войны» gloss in 大戦, «Мой» in 売れる, the unnamed reading behind 大家's «не «богатая семья»» and the bookish «округа» in 地域) were not adopted: each is inherited from EN or repaired by the following sentence, and the reviewer marked them polish, not defects. Its proposed contrast «а не похвала вроде «молодец!»» for 大統領 was not adopted, because Digital Daijisen's actor call is itself an encouraging cheer. No reviewer finding remains open.
